<!-- A method page as a consumer writes one: the split layout, a controls
     panel (formula + button row, then a grid of fields), and a chart block
     whose single step slider sits in the bar above a Plotly chart. -->

::::::::: {.vm-split}

```{ojs}
//| output: false
VM = window.VM
vmTheme = Generators.observe(notify => VM.plotting.onThemeChange(notify))
chartColors = VM.plotting.colors(vmTheme)
```

<div class="vm-app">

<div class="ojs-panel">

<div class="ojs-row">

```{ojs}
viewof fText = {
  const input = Inputs.text({label: "Function f(x)", value: "cos(x) - x"})
  input.classList.add("ojs-fill")
  return input
}
```

```{ojs}
viewof plotTrigger = {
  const button = Inputs.button("Plot", {value: 0, reduce: v => v + 1})
  button.classList.add("ojs-auto")
  return button
}
```

</div>

<div class="ojs-grid">

```{ojs}
viewof x0Text = Inputs.text({label: "Initial guess x₀", value: "3"})
```

```{ojs}
viewof maxText = Inputs.text({label: "Max iterations", value: "12"})
```

```{ojs}
viewof exampleSelect = Inputs.select(["cos(x) - x", "x^2 - 2"], {label: "Try an example"})
```

</div>

</div>

```{ojs}
//| output: false
iterates = {
  plotTrigger
  const f = VM.expressions.makeFunction(math, fText)
  const df = VM.expressions.makeDerivative(math, fText)
  const xs = [Number(x0Text)]
  for (let n = 0; n < Number(maxText); n++) {
    const x = xs[xs.length - 1]
    xs.push(x - f(x) / df(x))
  }
  return {f, xs}
}
```

<div class="ojs-chart-block">

<div class="ojs-chart-controls">

```{ojs}
viewof step = {
  const slider = Inputs.range([0, iterates.xs.length - 1], {step: 1, value: 0, label: "n"})
  slider.classList.add("ojs-fill")
  return slider
}
```

</div>

```{ojs}
mainPlot = {
  const xs = iterates.xs.slice(0, step + 1)
  const zeros = []
  for (let i = 0; i < xs.length; i++) zeros.push(0)
  const cx = [], cy = []
  for (let i = 0; i <= 200; i++) {
    const x = -4 + 8 * i / 200
    cx.push(x)
    cy.push(iterates.f(x))
  }
  const data = [
    {x: cx, y: cy, showlegend: false, line: {color: chartColors.fn}},
    {x: xs, y: zeros, mode: "markers", showlegend: false, marker: {color: chartColors.ok}}
  ]
  const div = document.createElement("div")
  div.className = "plotly-box-large"
  Plotly.newPlot(div, data, VM.plotting.layout({xaxis: {range: [-4, 4]}, yaxis: {range: [-6, 6]}}), VM.plotting.config())
  VM.plotting.autoResize(div)
  return div
}
```

</div>

</div>

Newton's method replaces $x_n$ by

$$
x_{n+1} = x_n - \frac{f(x_n)}{f'(x_n)},
$$

the root of the tangent line at $x_n$. The prose column scrolls beside the
app on a wide screen and follows it on a phone.
